summary: Round 1 review at 4d59c55e3: the documentation-only update meets the agreed scope. component-regression.md, the pr-regression.md edits and the controller README edit all say the current controller automatically gates only paired loop equivalence (+/-5%) and receipt integrity. They also say it does not collect or gate component counters, that native adapters and qualified bounds are still required, and that a loop-equivalent label alone is not performance acceptance. No new numerical counter bounds are invented; bounds must be frozen as a hashed artifact before candidate execution. The default stays six raw cases with one stream per BD, matching profile.json (six case IDs, n_gpu_streams=1). The three cited test functions exist and support the boundary claims (poll forbidden during issue_groups; live-reference windows never polled and CUDA-gated retirement; one callback per dispatched batch). The historical figures match input_group_bookkeeping.md (50,101->101 polls, 9.22->0.18 s instrumented two-stream polling self time, 50,000 reads and 100 callbacks unchanged, candidate visits not counted, Sim10 batch 100) and are explicitly not transferred as limits for run51/batch 20. Denominators, legitimate per-event/per-range work, per-rank versus aggregate values, overlapping waits, explicit unavailable observations, clean versus diagnostic separation and the single-sample profile phase (confirmed in campaign.py schedule) are all handled correctly. One low, non-blocking wording issue is noted.

findings.evidence: Lines 66-70 say to use reader io_stats for the counters it exports and the input-group source to choose hooks, then say 'That source does not provide all the observations listed above as a public statistics API.' In fact gpu_input_group.py has no statistics API at all (no poll, visit or issue counters). io_stats also lacks some Reader-row observations: it has no wait-call count, only wait-only total_ns. 'That source' is ambiguous about which of the two sources it means.
findings.requested_change: Optional wording fix: state that gpu_input_group.py exposes no counters, and that io_stats provides requests, requested/useful/total bytes and wait-only/issue-to-complete ns but no wait-call count, so those observations need reviewed instrumentation or must be recorded as unavailable.
